attachments.insertion_landmark: posterior tubercles of the transverse processes C1-C3

actions: rotates and laterally flexes the neck to the same side

functional_compartments.name: Single fiber population
functional_compartments.source: Gray's Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake, Vogl, Mitchell); Moore KL, Dalley AF, Agur AMR, Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.; Terminologia Anatomica (FICAT 1998)

injection_target_points.label: centre of the region of highest muscle spindle abundance
injection_target_points.method: modified Sihler's stain intramuscular nerve-dense region, with muscle-spindle abundance histology, localised by spiral CT with barium sulphate labelling
injection_target_points.notes: Deeper and further from the occiput than splenius capitis, on both reference lines.
injection_target_points.source: He X, Wen S, Liu X, Li Y, Yang S, 'Optimal target localization for botulinum toxin A in treating splenius muscles dystonia based on the distribution of intramuscular nerves and spindles', Anat Sci Int 101(1):44-53 (2025), doi:10.1007/s12565-025-00831-8 -- 24 adults, modified Sihler's staining with muscle-spindle histology and CT localisation
